body.message: The Al Safa 1BR is at AED 7,500, so a bit above your range. The closest we have to AED 6k are two studios in Business Bay: Upside Living at AED 5,500/month and DAMAC Maison Prive at AED 6,000/month, both fully furnished and all bills included. Would either of those work, or is a 1BR a must for you?
